author: fester
body: Walks the typed IR and emits a SPIR-V word stream (List Integer), the thing a driver actually consumes, using the primitives in SPIRV Binary. It is the binary twin of the disassembling emitter (SPIRV Emitter): same IR shapes, same lowering decisions, but every identifier is a number and every instruction is words, not text. The two will fold together once the text side becomes a disassembler over these words; until then this is the one that produces something dispatchable.

author: fester
body: A signature key: one character for the return type and one per parameter, f for a float, i for an integer. Two functions with the same key share one OpTypeFunction; the key also spells out the words the declaration needs, so the type list is built straight from it with no second walk of the defs.
